concern_summary: This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing and validating user personal details. It involves retrieving user information necessary for transactions and invoice submissions while ensuring data integrity through validation processes.

This concern focuses on the identification and validation of text containing right to left characters, addressing the functionality of detecting the presence of specific character types based on their directional classification.

This concern focuses on retrieving and managing the personal details of the current user, including their display attributes and profile information, to be used across various components and functionalities.
This concern addresses the display logic for user names in specific contexts, such as whisper chats, particularly when the current user is the sole participant.
This concern is about managing the rendering constraints for the canvas, specifically the maximum area, height, and width limits for content display.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to the user search process, including capturing and parsing user input for search queries and managing the state of search phrases associated with users.
